high_level_description: The image depicts a square decorative tile with intricate floral designs. The tile is predominantly yellow with a blue border around the edges. Within the yellow background, there are several smaller squares and rectangles filled with various floral patterns. In the center of the tile, there is a large blue square containing a symmetrical design of flowers and leaves. The flowers have pink petals with blue centers, and the leaves are green. Surrounding this central blue square is a white border that frames it neatly.
